title: 查閱照護資訊
checks: 只有指定動作與運鏡發生；沒有隨機切鏡
臉部清楚，肢體與接觸自然，背景不閃爍
生成長度、裁切範圍、參考素材標籤與模式一致

textCues.text: 妳回報的噁心程度偏高。
請依醫囑使用備用止吐藥；

prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action photographic realism. The shot begins from <Picture 1>, retaining the exact opening framing, lighting and character arrangement.  Live-action, photographic realism. A medium-close shot frames the same 32-year-old Taiwanese woman reclining on the sofa, wearing a gray cotton headwrap and charcoal hoodie over a gray undershirt. Her face retains youthful volume despite fatigue and mild nausea. Her left hand supports the solid phone; her right hand rests loosely near her chin. Initially she studies the display, then blinks slowly and exhales, settling into the same pose. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed. Warm room light and a dim neutral-white display illuminate natural skin; no green or cyan spill appears. The screen remains blank for later interface compositing. Her fingers stay outside the rigid phone edges. Preserve facial identity, age, wardrobe and lighting from the supplied visual sources. Initial object positions match the opening reference; only the explicitly described movements may change them. Keep the movement continuous with no cut or pose reset. Natural breathing and cloth motion continue between the specified actions. No subtitles, added graphics or new lettering are generated. People remain silent with lips naturally at rest; there is no dialogue, singing or narration. The full shot lasts 8.000 seconds. Keep one continuous shot, no captions or newly invented lettering.

overall_soundscape: Low room ambience, restrained breathing and soft fabric movements synchronized to the visible action. Phone handling produces only quiet contact sounds; there are no alerts or other voices.

non_diegetic_music: A very quiet slow felt-piano pattern with sustained low cello, no singing or percussion. Keep the score below speech, with no sudden swell; leave a gentle held tone at the end.
